content:
I have compared the options for the MeshNet Wi-Fi 6 Router. While Trailmart lists the router for $125.00 with free shipping, they require a minimum purchase of two units, which would exceed your budget. Therefore, Peakgear is the better deal for a single unit at $129.00 plus $5.99 shipping (total $134.99).

I have successfully placed the order for you at Peakgear.
